verdict.rationale: The probes show Stripe documents an official MCP server and publishes an llms.txt. That gives an indirect path for an AI agent to drive Stripe through natural-language prompts. However, the MCP probe is Stripe-wide, and nothing shows that crypto or stablecoin operations (onramp, stablecoin payouts, financial accounts) can actually be run this way. Missing for 10: evidence that crypto/stablecoin actions are exposed through the MCP server or another natural-language interface, documentation of natural-language command workflows, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
